assign.request: Can a newcomer misunderstand Make or Importance? Read each screen cold, press every control once at 1280/1920/3440 and once at 400, rank the defects by how badly a newcomer would misread the screen. Judge against the owner's rule: 'when looking at the sidebar, we want to see self-evident demos that are impossible to misunderstand. every button, every item, every part - perfectly clear what goes where, what does what, what clicks do, etc.'
assign.now: scoping - reading the two realms' readmes, opening a private server on 8098
steps: read cold - one sentence per pane, before any code
press everything on Make (probe pages only)
press everything on Importance (own judgments only)
rank the defects, one numbered log line each
clean up probes + judgments, verify git clean

log.msg: COLD READ, Make at 1280 - one sentence per pane before any code. Top strip: "On disk - 8 pages under made/" plus a bare "Reset" button, and I cannot guess what Reset resets (my pages? the demo data? the layout?). Left pane "Pages": a tree of made pages, each row a grip, a title, a star, a plus and an x; I read the star as "favourite", not as "open this child first". Middle: unlabelled - I guessed "a preview", and its own prose ("Writing a page...") reads like instructions FROM the tool rather than content OF the page being edited. Right pane: title/description/icon are obvious; the seven dropdowns are labelled and guessable; the two empty circles before CONTENT COLOUR / PAGE COLOUR read as unchecked radio buttons; "Code" I guessed right, "More" I could not guess at all; the three orange Prose/Card wall/Template buttons I read as "add a block". A whole paragraph under the tree explains the drag in words - the brief calls that a defect by definition.

COLD READ, Importance at 1280 - one sentence per pane before any code. Overview: a "Saved to disk" banner, the topic "Buying a used car", a grey box reading "Which matters more?" that I guessed is a link to the judging screen, "3 judgments cast here" as plain text, a Docs link, then three sentences of prose explaining the bars, then two ranked rows and a "Propose a question, option or caveat" disclosure. The big numeral 1 / 2 with a tiny "why?" under it is the only way to open the judgments and I did not read it as a control - I read "why?" as a caption. The caveat line "qualifies . unranked - no judgments yet" I could not parse at all: I do not know what "qualifies" is doing there. Judge screen: two cards side by side, each with a tiny "1" and a tiny arrow box under it; I could not tell whether I click the CARD or click the little boxes, and nothing on the screen says a click records a judgment or that another pair follows. The second input showing "you" has no label - I guessed "your name" only because the readme had told me judges are named. At 1280 both screens leave roughly a third to a half of the width empty.

MAKE PRESSED at 1280. Every control found and pressed except the two destructive confirms (Press again to forget the pages you made; ...or every demo on the site) which I armed and cancelled without firing. What works and is predictable: the drag (an orange dashed placeholder box at the landing slot and a ghost row on the cursor - clear), + add child, the x delete two-press, the seven dropdowns (each moves the middle on the same frame), the block list with its up/down/remove, typing a title (the h1 above the page follows the keystroke), clicking a child row inside the preview (the box swaps and says "open New page as its own page - this is where the url changes"). What does not: the star does not toggle off and changes nothing but itself; Code and More open the IDENTICAL drawer; that drawer opens on "There is no link to this exact page" while a real url link sits in the middle pane; the delete question truncates the page name to "D..." at 1280; the description field changes nothing visible anywhere; the icon chip and the FAMILY chip are cycles that look like selected state.

assign.now: pressing Importance - the ranked view and the judge screen

log.msg: DEFECT 1. MAKE - Code and More are the same button, and the panel they open says your page has no address and is not saved. A newcomer sees two buttons side by side, Code and More, presses one, and a panel slides in that pushes the three panes into one column; presses the other and gets the identical panel. Its first heading is THE LINK TO THIS PAGE and its first sentence is "There is no link to this exact page... Save it as a page and it gets a real address" - while the real address is a live link four inches to the left and the top of the screen says "On disk - 10 pages under made/". The fix: the panel is about the page you PICKED, so its first line must be that page's real url (the one the middle already shows), and Code must open the panel scrolled to THE SAME PAGE, AS CODE rather than repeating More. png: /framework/ai/2026-09-13/self-evident-critique/01-code-and-more-drawer-1280.png

DEFECT 2. MAKE - a page you just made opens showing somebody else's essay. Press New page and the middle fills with a 300-word article headed "Notes that other people can read" about a product called Northwind, under YOUR page's title and YOUR page's url. The only thing that says it is a canned sample is one line of 12px grey text below the whole article - off screen at a 900px window. The fix: put that sentence ABOVE the box as an eyebrow on the sample itself ("sample text - the CONTENT word draws this until you add a block"), the way the eyebrow already works when blocks are present. png: /framework/ai/2026-09-13/self-evident-critique/02-new-page-sample-essay-1280.png

DEFECT 3. MAKE - the delete question truncates the page's name to one letter at 1280. Press the x on a row and the row becomes a question, which is right - but at 1280 the tree pane is 210px and the question renders as "D... [Delete it] [Cancel]". The one control whose whole job is to say what it is about to destroy says "D". The fix: the question wraps to two lines inside the row instead of ellipsising, or it moves under the row; the name and the count of pages under it must always be readable. png: /framework/ai/2026-09-13/self-evident-critique/03-delete-question-truncated-1280.png

DEFECT 4. IMPORTANCE - nothing on the judge screen says a card is clickable, and the keys it does show are dead as soon as you touch the name field. Two cards sit side by side under "Which matters more?", each with a small 1 and an arrow drawn as key caps; there is no "pick one" instruction, no button, and the card's only affordance is the cursor. Worse, the natural first move is to click the box that says "you" and type your name - and the 1 / 2 / arrow keys then type into that box and cast nothing, which is exactly "I press the key and nothing happens". The fix: one line above the pair - "click the one that matters more, or press its key" - and blur the name field on Enter so the keys work again. png: /framework/ai/2026-09-13/self-evident-critique/04-judge-cards-no-instruction-1280.png

DEFECT 5. MAKE - the star fills, changes nothing else, and cannot be pressed off. The star on a row means "open this child first when its parent opens"; pressing it turns the outline into a filled orange star and NOTHING else on the screen moves - not the tree, not the middle, not the settings. Pressing it again does nothing at all: measured, the star stayed filled and the count of filled stars stayed 1, so a newcomer who mis-clicks cannot undo it. The fix: a second press clears the default, and the starred row shows the reason in words (a small "opens first" tag on the row), not only a star. png: /framework/ai/2026-09-13/self-evident-critique/05-star-does-nothing-1280.png

DEFECT 6. IMPORTANCE - the item's name is the navigation control, and where it takes you has no way back. On the ranked view the biggest text on each row - "Has it been in an accident?" - is a link with no underline, no colour and no icon; cold, I did not guess it was clickable. Clicking a CAVEAT's name ("Carfax misses unreported accidents") lands on a screen with no breadcrumb at all, because up() only follows the downward relations and a caveat hangs upward - the browser's back button is the only way home. The fix: mark the name as a link (the site's link colour on hover at least) and make the trail follow "qualifies" edges too, so every node has a way back. png: /framework/ai/2026-09-13/self-evident-critique/06-judge-dead-end-no-trail-1280.png

DEFECT 7. MAKE - the most destructive control on the screen needs ONE press; the less destructive one needs two. Pressing Reset arms a two-press confirm - "Press again to forget the pages you made" with a Cancel beside it, which is right. Sitting in that same row is "...or every demo on the site", which clears every saved key on the origin - every page you made, every board, every run anywhere on the site - on a single press, with no second question. The fix: give the site-wide clear its own second press and say the count it is about to forget, or take it off this row. png: /framework/ai/2026-09-13/self-evident-critique/07-one-press-site-wipe-1280.png

DEFECT 8. MAKE - one orange chip means three different things on one screen. In the right pane an orange chip means "this value is selected" (CARDS OF children/templates), and an orange chip means "press me to add a block" (Prose, Card wall, Template), and an orange chip means "press me to cycle to the next of eleven" (FAMILY magazine, and the ICON chip above). A newcomer reading FAMILY magazine sees a selected value, not a button, and never discovers the other ten. The fix: cycles are not chips - give ICON and FAMILY the same labelled dropdown the seven words use, and keep the orange fill for "selected". png: /framework/ai/2026-09-13/self-evident-critique/08-orange-chip-three-meanings-1600.png

DEFECT 9. IMPORTANCE - the screen explains in three sentences what the picture should say, and the trace control is the word "why?". Above the two rows sits "Ranked by how often each one won a head-to-head comparison inside this topic. The number beside a bar is the score and how much is behind it; press a rank to see the judgments themselves" - a paragraph describing a bar chart that is right underneath it. The only way to open the judgments is a 9px "why?" under the rank numeral, which reads as a caption, and the sentence is what tells you it is a control. The fix: delete the paragraph, put "won 3 of 3" beside the bar where the percentage is, and draw the trace control as a control (a labelled row toggle), so the picture carries the sentence.

DEFECT 10. IMPORTANCE - the judge screen shows the two things' current scores before you judge them, and offers "Which matters more?" on nodes with nothing to compare. Each card carries "100% of 3 judgments" against "0% of 1 judgment", so the pair you are asked to rank arrives with the answer printed on it. And on a leaf (any caveat, or any question with nothing under it) the big "Which matters more?" button is still the primary action and dead-ends on "There are not two things here yet to compare". The fix: hide the score on the judge cards until after the pick (then show both, which is the reward), and grey the button out where store.children() is under two, with the reason on it.

COUNTS. Make, at 1280 with Notes picked: 61 visible control INSTANCES (8 tree rows x 4 controls each is 32 of them) in 42 distinct KINDS; 40 of the 42 pressed. The two I did not press are the two that destroy the owners data - "Press again to forget the pages you made" and "...or every demo on the site" - both of which I armed, read and cancelled. Importance, both screens: 14 distinct control kinds (Which matters more?, Docs, the rank/why? box, the item name, the attachment name, the trail up-link, the Propose disclosure, its kind dropdown, its text field, its author field, Add, a judge card, the reason field, the judge name field, See the ranking - and the 1/2/arrow keys); 13 of 14 pressed, the trail up-link only on a question (on a caveat it does not exist, which is finding 6).

RUN CONDITIONS AND WHAT I DID NOT REPORT. Twice during a burst of edits the whole tab reloaded and Makes selection reset to the first page in the tree; I chased it with a stamp probe (create a page, poll for 19s) and could NOT reproduce it, and the servers watcher ignores every .json write, so I am recording it as a sibling agents save firing LiveReload, not as a defect of the screen. Two more things I saw and left out of the ten: at room=Full a made page at its own url shows no h1 and a bare "/" bar, while the ROOM dropdown still reads Full after you press "leave full screen"; and the drawer that More opens carries a THIRD full set of the seven words as chips, beside the settings dropdowns and the bar - three controls for one word, against the realms own one-name-one-control rule.

CLEANUP CHECK 1 - the pages. Both probe pages were created and deleted through the UI (x, then "Delete it"). `git status --porcelain public/imagine/paging/made/` after is byte-identical to the snapshot I took before touching anything (3 modified page.json files and 2 untracked dirs, all the owners), and `find public/imagine/paging/made -type f` matches the before list exactly. One extra restore was needed: pressing the star on a top-level page rewrites EVERY top-level siblings file, which dirtied made/archive/page.json (it had been clean); I put it back with `git show HEAD:<path> > <path>`, never `checkout --`.

CLEANUP CHECK 2 - the judgments. I cast 2 judgments (one by click, one by keyboard) and proposed 1 node; all four lines - 2 in judgments/2026-09.jsonl, 1 in nodes.jsonl, 1 in edges.jsonl - were removed by id. `git diff --stat public/imagine/importance/data/` is empty, but that check is vacuous here because the whole data/ dir is UNTRACKED (`??`) - so the real proof is md5sum, and all three files hash byte-identical to the snapshot I took before the first judgment: edges cc5bb7bd337cfdc2260ef6784e0fd83b, judgments 9234ba29a679671f34850abb891f80c9, nodes 20ab6e357f54a33efe0eeaad1c3ce473.
private server on 8098 killed by pid 27636; port free. Port 80 never touched, no tabs driven but my own headless one, no git stash, no commit.

assign.outcome:
**Ten ranked defects, pressed not guessed — and Importance is the closer of the two to "impossible to misunderstand".** I read both screens cold, wrote a guess per pane, then pressed 40 of Make's 42 control kinds and 13 of Importance's 14, at 1280 / 1920 / 3440 / 400.

**The top five**

1. **Make · `Code` and `More` are the same button**, and the panel they open opens on *"There is no link to this exact page... Save it as a page and it gets a real address"* — while the real url is a live link in the middle pane and the top of the screen says *On disk — 10 pages under `made/`*. ![](01-code-and-more-drawer-1280.png)
2. **Make · a page you just made shows somebody else's essay** — 300 words about a product called *Northwind*, under your title and your url; the one line that says it is a sample is 12px grey text below the whole article, off screen at a 900px window. ![](02-new-page-sample-essay-1280.png)
3. **Make · the delete question truncates the page name to `D…`** at 1280 — the one control whose whole job is to say what it destroys says one letter. ![](03-delete-question-truncated-1280.png)
4. **Importance · nothing says a judge card is clickable**, and the keys it *does* show die the moment you click the unlabelled `you` box to type your name — the digit lands in your name and no judgment is cast. ![](04-judge-cards-no-instruction-1280.png)
5. **Make · the star fills, moves nothing else, and cannot be pressed off** — measured: a second press left it filled and the count unchanged. ![](05-star-does-nothing-1280.png)

Six to ten, one `log` line each in this task: the caveat page with no way back · the one-press site-wide wipe beside a two-press one · the orange chip that means three different things · the paragraph doing a bar chart's job · the judge cards printing the answer before you pick.

**Clean** — `git status public/imagine/paging/made/` and its file list are byte-for-byte what they were before I started (one restore needed: the star rewrites every top-level sibling's file). All four rows I wrote to `importance/data/` were removed by id; `git diff --stat` there is vacuous (the dir is untracked) so the proof is md5 — all three files hash identical to the pre-run snapshot. Private server on 8098 killed by pid; port 80 untouched.

**Left** — the two destructive confirms were armed, read and cancelled, never fired. A tab reload that twice reset Make's selection would not reproduce under a stamp probe and the server ignores every `.json` write, so it is logged as a sibling's LiveReload, not a defect.
